scope.flow: WERC7575Vault.withdraw() authorization for withdrawing on behalf of an owner
scope.environment: WERC7575Vault share-token vault with self-allowance mechanism

statements.text: The victim owner has obtained a self-allowance through a validator permit signature.
The attacker calls withdraw(assets, attacker_address, victim_address) on WERC7575Vault.

WERC7575Vault.withdraw() does not implement the authorization check described in its comment (msg.sender must be owner OR have allowance for the shares); it only calls _shareToken.spendSelfAllowance(owner, shares), which checks the owner's self-allowance rather than the caller's authorization.
WERC7575Vault.withdraw() must verify that msg.sender is the owner or has allowance for the shares before withdrawing on behalf of the owner.

ambiguities: Report does not state the exact assets/shares amount or whether the victim's full balance is withdrawn in the described call.
Report does not specify the concrete permit/validator mechanism or timing by which self-allowance is established beyond the attack-path step.
